parties.respondent: M/S. Lalta Prasad Vaish and sons

summary: Legislative competence on intoxicating liquor; scope of Entry 8 List II vs Entry 52 List I; interpretation of 'intoxicating liquor' as potable vs non-potable alcohol; correctness of Synthetics (7J) reference; harmonious reading of constitutional entries; impact on industrial alcohol regulation; State power over liquor production/sale confirmed for potable alcohol only; Entry 8 limited to human consumption; industrial alcohol falls under central control.
final_judgment: Reference answered; Synthetics (7J) decision set aside; Entry 8 List II interpreted as confined to potable alcohol; industrial alcohol regulated by Union under Entry 52 List I.
